policies.title: Lesotho ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Lesotho as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to a Lesotho ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Lesotho ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Lesotho visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a Lesotho ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Lesotho ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule places Lesotho in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring approval before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Lesotho ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not separately qualify for Panama's third-country-visa or residence waiver.
The Embassy says authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days and tells applicants not to finalize travel before it is granted.
The Embassy's personal-appearance requirements are jurisdiction-specific; work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
